title: Encoding of a signed boundary position
statement: Let $s$ be a Boolean value and let $a$ be a natural number. Define $e=-a-1$ when $s$ is true and $e=a$ when $s$ is false. Under the encoding $a(e)=-e-1$ for negative $e$ and $a(e)=e$ otherwise, one has $a(e)=a$.
